https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cmwyq6.text: Moment drone hits supermarket in Odesa Moment drone hits supermarket in Odesa Close CCTV video verified by the BBC shows the moment of a drone strike on a supermarket in the town of Mayaky in Ukraine's Odesa region. The drone can be seen flying into the roof of the Tavria supermarket and exploding on impact. Three people were injured in the attack, according to President Volodymyr Zelensky, who blamed Russia for the attack. Russia's war in Ukraine is in its fifth year, which has been raging since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. http://www.jpost.com/international/artic.text: Three people were injured in a stabbing attack at a further education college in Warsaw on Saturday, police said, the latest in a series of incidents that have stoked concerns in Poland about copycat violence among young people.On Friday, thousands of police visited schools nationwide to try to reassure pupils after two stabbing sprees by teenagers in as many days sparked rumors of potential further attacks, fears that Saturday's incident is likely to intensify."At 12:30 today, we received a report of an incident involving the use of a dangerous weapon," police spokesperson Jakub Filipiak told Reuters."One person was injured and transported to the hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. Two other bystanders also sustained injuries but did not require hospitalization."He said the attacker was a 21-year-old student of the college.Polish police step up security amid fears of further school attacksState news agency PAP reported that the victims were two 17-year-old girls and a 24-year-old woman who had come to submit enrollment documents. Preliminary police findings indicated that the attacker and victims did not know one another, PAP reported.Police said on Saturday they had inspected some 50,000 facilities since Friday and detained 76 people. Authorities had previously said most of the people detained were teenagers who had made threats online.On Thursday, a 15-year-old former pupil wearing a helmet-mounted camera killed a caretaker and injured two teachers at a primary school in Leszczydol-Nowiny, northeast of Warsaw. On Wednesday, a 19-year-old wounded 10 people including himself at a school in Ostroleka, north of the capital.
